Frontend Engineer — Entry Level
Tessellate

We are rebuilding our customer dashboard and need a frontend engineer to own
large parts of it.

Responsibilities
- Build accessible, responsive interfaces in React and TypeScript
- Translate Figma designs into production components
- Write component tests
- Improve performance: our dashboard loads too slowly and you will help fix it

Requirements
- Strong JavaScript fundamentals — closures, promises, the event loop
- Proficiency with React, including hooks and state management
- TypeScript required
- Solid CSS: flexbox, grid, responsive layout
- Understanding of web accessibility (semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation)
- Experience consuming REST APIs

Preferred
- Next.js
- Testing with Jest, Vitest or React Testing Library
- Familiarity with Tailwind CSS
- Interest in data visualisation, D3 or otherwise
- Experience with Core Web Vitals and performance profiling
